messages:
max (Procure): FYI LedgerDrop sent the renewal + a proposed \"usage smoothing\" experiment. They also attached an invoice with weird line items (session-context vs payload). Need quick read.

sana (Finance): Paste the numbers and the odd lines. I can run a quick sensitivity.

max (Procure): Baseline 1.0B tokens/mo. Renewal options: flat commit $29k/mo for 1.5B net tokens; metered $0.022/1k; experiment = variable commit that discounts tiers based on net dedupe rate. They flagged \"context-session tokens\" separately on the invoice.

kai (Platform): We do local dedupe/caching. Key Q: does their \"net\" count after our client-side dedupe + their server dedupe? window length? per-tenant or global?

billing-bot: BillingOps note: Invoice LD-2026-04 had a 10% mismatch vs our usage; ticket #1777 opened for recon.

jules (Legal): Also need to check shortfall/true-up and termination. If we commit then drop usage, what is the liability? Add right to audit the reconciliation feed.

sana (Finance): If \"context-session\" tokens are billed separately and not part of the commit, it materially changes the math. Max 1 can you ask them to quantify context tokens as a percent of total?

max (Procure): Messaged LedgerDrop: \"Confirm committed credits apply to post-dedupe unique tokens; define context-session tokens and whether they count toward commit; provide sample reconciliation feed (parquet/json) and S3 path; confirm true-up cadence and POC credits.\"

ledgerdrop-sales (vendor): Reply: \"Committed credits apply after our dedupe. Context-session tokens billed separately. We can provide daily redacted parquet feeds to S3 and offer a 45-day POC with 80% credit first 30 days. Quarterly true-ups.\"

kai (Platform): We need the dedupe spec: TTL/window, scope, hashing algorithm tolerance. Also request hashed token prefixes in feed so we can validate without sharing plaintext.

jules (Legal): Contract asks: 1) right to audit monthly redacted reconcile feeds for 12 months, 2) definition of context tokens in SOW, 3) quarterly reconciliations with credits for misbilling >1%, 4) 30-day rollback on experiments.

sana (Finance): I'll build three scenarios tonight: conservative (no dedupe), expected (25% net reduction), optimistic (45% net). Max 1 send vendor's cost breakout and POC terms link.

max (Procure): Sent vendor breakouts to the sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/ledgerdrop-renewal. Also requested sample redacted feed schema.

billing-bot: Note: reconciliation automation can ingest parquet if schema matches. Ops please confirm acceptance of S3 format.

kai (Platform): I'll validate S3 schema and run a simulated reconcile on last 30 days by EOD. If vendor POC matches our sim within +/-5% and legal language is acceptable, leaning to commit+POC.

max (Procure): TL;DR: Accept POC only if vendor provides auditable redacted feeds, clear context token definition, and quarterly true-up with credit. Otherwise prefer metered with negotiated cap and lower overage.
